defaultModel.description: Model for new tasks, as provider/model (for example anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5).

maxWorkers.description: How many tasks run at once.

sameFolder.description: Let two tasks work in the same project folder at the same time.

reasoning.description: auto: more thinking for Think tasks, less for Write. off: faster, for small local models.

userSkills.description: Also offer your personal skills in ~/.agents/skills to workers.

notifications.description: Show a browser notification when a task finishes or needs you while Rumi is in the background.

approvals.description: When Build tasks must ask before running a shell command: never, after the task has read a web page (default), or always.

checkpoints.description: Snapshot the project folder before each Build task so its changes can be reviewed and reverted.

worktrees.description: Run Build tasks in a separate git worktree and branch, merged when you choose. Git repositories only.

allowPrivateNetwork.description: Let read_page open addresses on this computer or your local network. Off protects against prompt injection.

updateCheck.description: Check GitHub once a day for a newer version. Nothing about you is sent.

providers.description: Engines queried together and merged. Bing is used as a fallback when all return nothing.

searxngUrl.description: Base URL of a SearXNG instance with the JSON format enabled, for example http://localhost:8888.

mcpServers.description: MCP servers workers can use, in the same format as Claude Desktop, Cursor and Pi. Turn each one on per workspace.

shortcuts.description: Keyboard shortcuts. Mod is Ctrl, or Cmd on macOS.

packages.description: Pi packages installed in Rumi (managed from Settings).
